content: Mbali saba ya inyela jaka Chapanga

Bhela, nakajowini sauti ngolongwa kuhuma mu Nyumba jaka Chapanga ja kunani kumahunde hoku, jakabhapwaghila bhatumika saba bha kunani kumahunde bhala, “Njendanyaje mkajitala mbali saba yeibhi na inyela jaka Chapanga pundema!”

Mtumika wa kutumbula wa kunani kumahunde akapiti kujitila mbali jaki panani ja pundema. Pakapitali maputi mahakau na ghaghapoteka nakanope, ghakabhapatiki bhandu bhokapi bhabhakabhi na alama jaka chinyama chela, na bhandu bhala bhabhakachijojabhi chimong'umong'u chake.
Mtumika wa kabheli wa kunani kumahunde akajiti mbali jaki panani ja bahali. Najombi bahali jakang'anambwiki jakabhili ngati mwahi waka mundu joapotile, na ihumbi yomi yokapi ya mubahali yakapotile.
Mtumika wa katatu wa kunani kumahunde akajiti mbali jaki panani ja mikoka na chemichemi ya machi, nayombi yakabhi mwahi.
Nakunjowini mtumika wa kunani kumahunde, njemalela wa machi akapwaghaje, “Wehapa nde Mhuhu, weubhile na weukabhile, maghambu wehapa utemwili ngati moipalakila!
Maghambu bhakabhakomiki bhahuhu bhaku na bhalota bhaku, nanau ubhapeki mwahi bhakunywaje ngati moibhapalakila!”
Bhela nakajowini sauti kuhuma pa chihanja cha kuhuki ubani jakapwaghaje, “Ena, Bambo Chapanga Mweni Makili! Utemulu waku nde wamboni na wa chakaka.”
Panihapa, mtumika wa kachechi wa kunani kumahunde akajiti mbali jaki panani ja lyobha. Lyobha lakapekiwi makili gha kubhajocha bhandu kwa kupyopa kwaki.

Bhandu bhakajochakiki chihakau na kupyopa kola, bhakalitondwi lihina laka Chapanga, joabhi na lujiniku panani ja malapuliku ghanihagha. Nambu bhakakaniki kung'anambuka na kughaleka mahoku ghabhu na kundumbali Chapanga.

Bhela mtumika wa kahanu wa kunani kumahunde jola akajiti mbali jaki panani ja chitehu cha kikolongwa chaka chinyama chikali chela. Lubhendu lukayekiki ukolongwa waki, bhandu bhakamemini lulimi lwabhu kwa ndandi ja mabhinilu,
bhakuntondwi Chapanga wa kunani kumahunde kwa ndandi ja mabhinilu ghabhu na maputi ghabhu. Nambu bhakakaniki kung'anambuka na kughaleka matendu ghabhu mahakau.

Bhela, mtumika wa sita wa kunani kumahunde akajiti mbali jaki panani ja nkoka ukolongwa ghoulowakeka Eufulati. Machi ghaki ghakajomalile, nahuli jipitalya indela kwa ndandi ja bhakolongwa bhabhahuma upambala wa kolipita lyobha.

Panihapa, nakaiweni roho itatu ihakau yeyabhonakini ngati mahungula, jimu jakapitiki mundomu wa lijoka likolongwa lela, na jengi jakapitiki mundomu jaka chinyama chela, na jengi jakapitiki mundomu jaka mlota wa icholi jola.

Yeniheyi nde roho ya majobhi yeihenga ngangachu. Yeniheyi nde roho yeijenda kwa bhakolongwa bhokapi bha pundema na kubhabhongana papamu kwa ndandi ja ngondo ja lichobha lela likolongwa laka Chapanga Mweni Makili.
“Lingalyaje! Nepani nhika ngati mwihe! Mbanga mundu jola joachelukila na kuwata ingobhu yaki nahuli ngayihika kujenda heu akwo na akwo na kulipoha iyoni pamihu ja bhandu!”
Bhela, roho ihakau heyi yakabhabhongini bhakolongwa pandu papalowakeka kwa Kiebulania Halimagedoni.

Bhela, mtumika wa saba wa kunani kumahunde akajiti mbali jaki mu lianga. Sauti ngolongwa jakajowaniki kuhuma pachiteu cha kikolongwa, mu Nyumba jaka Chapanga jejibhi kunani kumahunde, jakapwaghaje, “Kila chindu chijomwi kuhengakeka!”

Pakapitali unang'anu wa chitobhi, kunguluma, manjobhela na kubhaghaja kukolongwa kwa ndema, ambaku ngachekulabhali kupitalila kutumbu Chapanga paakumbombiki mundu, kwa ntundu mokwabheli kukolongwa kubhaghaja hoku kwa ndema.

Muchi ukolongwa ghola ukaghabhaniki ipambala itatu, na michi ja mataifa ghokapi jakahawike. Chapanga akaukombwiki Babeli muchi ghola ukolongwa. Akaukengiki chikombi cha divai ja inyela jaki ngolongwa.
Kila chilu chakabhowakike, wala itombi ngacheyabhonakini kabhete.

Bhela iyula ja maganga makolongwa ghaghabhi na kutopa kwa ngati kilu hamsini kila limu, ghakabhatonyili bhandu. Nabhombi bhakuntondwi Chapanga kwa ndandi ja malapuliku gha iyula ja maganga heji, maghambu lilapuliku la iyula ja maganga heji lakabhi nde likolongwa nakanope.
